by: Sam Hernandez, in person on Sam's laptop (app at ballroom-quest main, local)
testers: 4 first-timers who have never danced ballroom (not YBDT members); no ballroom dancers were available
method: Informal: each tester played the game while Sam watched; comments written down by Sam right after. No scores, timings or before/after ratings were recorded.

responses.said: This looks incredible. ... Wow, incredible. This is so amazing. This could be super helpful, and I could see myself using it.
responses.also: Surprised that the mechanics look so good; liked how simple it is and the different camera views while playing the character.

responses.said: Wow, this looks just like Dancing with the Stars.
Wow, the animations look really great. How did you get them to dance so well? How did you map out the dances?
Really enjoyed playing the game; would feel confident if they had to learn a dance and used this.

not_measured: time to fix a broken routine
minutes per week of intended use
